about.title: Invest in Your Child's Future
about.subtitle: Discover Golden Football Academy
about.desc1: At Golden Academy, we believe every child has a talent waiting to be discovered and developed. We help children learn the fundamentals of football and improve their skills, from their very first touch to mastering the game on the pitch.
about.desc2: We provide specialized football training for children aged 3 to 12, taking into account each player's age and skill level while helping them improve their football abilities and build self-confidence.
about.desc3: Our goal goes beyond teaching football. We also focus on developing teamwork, discipline, cooperation, and respect. At Golden Academy, we help your child enjoy the game, learn, and grow in a suitable training environment inside El Tayaran Club in New Cairo.
about.imageTitle: We Teach Football. We Build Champions.
about.imageSubtitle: A Journey of Skills and Confidence

players.title: Meet the Stars of Golden Academy
players.subtitle: We are proud of every player in the Golden family. Every child deserves the opportunity to learn, grow, and show their full potential on the pitch.

program1.title: Physical Fitness & Athletic Skills
program1.desc: We work on developing players' physical abilities through age- and level-appropriate exercises:
points: Developing speed, agility, balance, and motor coordination.
Improving movement and body control during play.
Gradual training that considers each player's age and physical ability.
Developing flexibility and stamina through suitable activities for children.
Prioritizing player safety during all training sessions.

program2.title: Technical & Football Skills Training
program2.desc: We help players learn the fundamentals of football and improve their skills:
points: Learning ball control, receiving, and passing.
Improving dribbling and movement with the ball.
Learning the fundamentals of teamwork and positioning on the pitch.
Gradually developing skills according to each player's age and level.

program3.title: Character Development & Football Intelligence
program3.desc: Football is an opportunity to learn skills that go beyond the pitch:
points: Encouraging commitment, discipline, and respect for instructions.
Learning cooperation and the spirit of teamwork.
Developing focus and football intelligence during play.
Building a positive character that enjoys learning and growth.
